question: to the Commission Cynthia Ní Mhurchú (Renew) Subject:

Can the Commission clarify whether any EU funding instruments, including the European Fund for Sustainable Development Plus, currently support digital civic participation and citizen engagement infrastructure, and does it intend to increase support for citizen science and digital democracy initiatives aimed at strengthening public participation and addressing the so-called democracy gap in the EU?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (3.8.2026) The Commission supports citizen engagement and democratic participation through several EU programmes. Under Horizon Europe1, support includes citizen participation in research and innovation, digital democracy, AI-enabled deliberation tools and 2026-2027 actions on citizen science, youth engagement and scientific literacy. The Commission cooperates with European Research Area (ERA) countries and stakeholders to implement the 2025-2027 ERA policy agenda action on enhancing trust in science through citizen participation and science communication. The Development Education and Awareness Raising in Europe (DEAR) programme2 promotes awareness of global development issues and active engagement for justice, human rights, democracy, gender equality and sustainable development. The Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values (CERV) programme3 supports citizens’ engagement, democratic participation and civil society. Creative Europe and Digital Europe strengthen media literacy and resilience against disinformation. The European Democracy Shield4 supports a European civic tech hub, pilot projects on civic tech and participatory digital tools, national authorities on citizen participation and strengthened media literacy. Under the Multiannual Financial Framework 2028-2034, the proposed AgoraEU programme, notably the CERV+ strand, would support democratic participation, citizens’ engagement, civil society, media freedom and democratic resilience, including through the European Democracy Shield. The proposed Horizon Europe programme would support research and innovation on democratic values, civic engagement, citizen involvement in research and innovation and the integrity of the information and media space.
